title: PUT /users/{id}/pin – request
description: Set a new PIN for the user: the given one, or (pin absent) a generated one, returned once (pin in the response). Unique among the users of all of the user's sites: a taken PIN is 409 conflict. Only for a user every site of whom is a site of the caller (otherwise 403 forbidden: a supervisor of one shared site must not take over the account of a colleague who also manages other sites); a user changes their own e-mail address, password and PIN. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/user.response.json.
